mapper.sql: project_id, user_id, enabled, granted_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from project_member where project_id=#{projectId} and user_id=#{userId}
select from project_member where project_id=#{projectId} order by ${q.orderBy}, user_id limit #{q.size} offset #{q.offset}
select count(*) from project_member where project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into project_member (project_id,user_id,enabled,granted_by,created_at,updated_at) values (#{projectId},#{userId},#{enabled},#{grantedBy},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) on duplicate key update enabled=values(enabled),granted_by=values(granted_by),updated_at=values(updated_at)
